summary: Tested employee export/import UI on /employees (https://image-render-test.preview.emergentagent.com). Seeded localStorage with 3 employees (Max Mustermann/Anna Beispiel/Tom Test) + settings object {disclaimer_accepted_at, disclaimer_version:'2026-06', is_pro:true}. Verified ALL 9 critical flows visually + programmatically: (A) 3-dot ellipsis-vertical icon visible in blue header (top-right, ~362,33) when NOT in selection mode; share-outline cyan icon + red trash visible on every card. (B) Tapping menu opens white card with exactly 3 options: 'Alle exportieren' (3 Mitarbeiter als JSON), 'Auswahl exportieren' (Einzelne Mitarbeiter auswählen), 'Importieren' (JSON-Datei auswählen) — divider between export and import as expected. (C) 'Auswahl exportieren' enters selection mode: header bg flips 25,118,210→8,145,178 (cyan #0891b2 confirmed), title shows '0 ausgewählt', 'Alle' toggle + X icon appear on right, checkboxes appear on every card, per-card share/trash icons disappear. (D) Tapping a card (Max Mustermann) toggles selection, title increments to '1 ausgewählt' and FAB 'X exportieren' appears at bottom. (E) Header 'Alle' selects all 3 (title→'3 ausgewählt', FAB→'3 exportieren'), label flips to 'Keine'. (F) 'Keine' deselects all (back to '0 ausgewählt'). (G) X button exits selection mode, header returns to blue '#1976d2' / 'Mitarbeiter'. (H) Importieren option triggers native file chooser (filechooser event captured). No console errors. No PageErrors. No deprecated expo packages — uses expo-file-system, expo-sharing, expo-document-picker (all current).

issues: Menu/card touch targets are well-sized (>44px). Header right buttons (paddingHorizontal:8, paddingVertical:4) yield ~34x32 — slightly under the 44px iOS HIG minimum. Low priority — works fine in practice and matches the rest of the app's header style.

action_items: OPTIONAL (not blocking): Add testID props to the header menu button, menu items ('Alle exportieren', 'Auswahl exportieren', 'Importieren'), the per-card share button, the FAB, and the 'Alle/Keine' toggle so future regression tests don't depend on coordinate clicks or text matching. Suggested testIDs: employees-header-menu, menu-export-all, menu-export-selection, menu-import, employee-card-share-<id>, employees-fab-export, employees-toggle-select-all.

OPTIONAL: Long-press to enter selection mode was not programmatically verifiable on web (Pressable.onLongPress doesn't reliably fire from synthetic pointer events). Real device touch behavior should be validated separately if user reports issues.
OPTIONAL: Bump header right button padding to reach 44px touch target (current ~32px height).
critical_code_review_comments: handleExport correctly auto-resets selection state only on the success branch (Sharing.shareAsync resolved). On web where Sharing.isAvailableAsync() returns false the Alert path keeps the selection — acceptable since the user can re-trigger without re-selecting.

handleImport duplicate check uses name.toLowerCase().trim() — matches the requested spec. Two edge cases worth noting (NOT bugs, just observations): (1) duplicates within the imported file itself are NOT cross-checked against each other (only against existing) — so an import file with [{name:'Max'},{name:'max'}] would import both if neither matches existing names; (2) imported items inherit hourly_rate exactly (even if NaN) — fine because EmployeeMasterService.create accepts the value as-is.
Exported JSON shape exactly matches spec: { type:'aufmassprofi-employees', version:1, exported_at:ISO, count:N, employees:[...] } — verified by code review of handleExport (lines 99-105).
Importable shapes: Array.isArray(parsed) || Array.isArray(parsed?.employees) — both raw-array and wrapped-format accepted as required (lines 150-154).

menuVisible state declared after useEffect that references openMenu — this works because openMenu is referenced inside a callback (not at module init), but stylistically it would be cleaner to declare state + handler before the useEffect (line 79 vs line 71). No functional issue.
Imports look correct: expo-file-system / expo-sharing / expo-document-picker are all modern, supported. expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch NOT used.
seed_data_creation: On https://image-render-test.preview.emergentagent.com origin: localStorage['aufmassprofi_settings'] = OBJECT (not array) with disclaimer_accepted_at + disclaimer_version='2026-06' + is_pro=true + company_name='Test GmbH'; localStorage['aufmassprofi_employees_master'] = [{id:'emp-1',name:'Max Mustermann',role:'Dachdecker',hourly_rate:45,...}, {id:'emp-2',name:'Anna Beispiel',role:'Gesellin',hourly_rate:40,...}, {id:'emp-3',name:'Tom Test',role:'Azubi',hourly_rate:15,...}]. Storage key for employees is 'aufmassprofi_employees_master' (per KEYS.EMPLOYEES in LocalStorage.ts).
context_for_next_testing_agent: (1) Expo-router native-stack header does NOT use <header> element — it's a plain <div> at top:0,height~64px,bg=rgb(25,118,210) in normal mode / rgb(8,145,178) in selection mode. Click coordinates around (362,33) hit the 3-dot button. (2) Per-card share button is the cyan share-outline icon (Ionicons), positioned just left of the red trash. (3) Settings object MUST be a plain object (not array) — DisclaimerGate uses SettingsService.get() which JSON.parses directly. (4) Employees storage key is 'aufmassprofi_employees_master'. (5) Long-press onLongPress in RN-web Pressable is hard to fire via synthetic Pointer/Mouse events — use real touch events or a long-running mousedown+timeout if needed. (6) Sharing.shareAsync on web triggers a download fallback inside expo-sharing; on this sandbox it may either succeed (download) or show the path Alert — both are valid per requirements.
